simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַהֲוָא (H163) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַהֲוָא (ʼAhăvâʼ) means Ahava , a river of Babylonia First listed occurrence: Ezra 8 15.

definitions.full: H163. Ahava אַהֲוָא proper name, of a location town or district in Babylonia , by which a stream is designated Ezra 8:15 , 31 , also the stream 8:21 ( א ׳הנהו ), 8:31 ( א ׳נְהַר ).
